description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to RunC container implementation and management within the WPEFramework's process container system. It includes class declarations for RunCContainer and RunCContainerAdministrator, with methods for container lifecycle management, configuration, and logging.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via RunC, providing methods for lifecycle control such as start, stop, and status queries.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages multiple RunCContainer instances, providing creation, destruction, and configuration functionalities.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the container.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on provided ID and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Configures logging options for container management.

methods.name: DestroyContainer
methods.description: Removes a container and cleans up resources.

methods.name: ContainerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a container name is already in use.
